property_summary: For any caller, after calling setOwner with any address, the owner must remain unchanged unless the caller is the current owner; the bug allows any caller to change it.

After any call to setOwner, the owner state variable must equal the argument passed to setOwner; the buggy version sets it to msg.sender instead, so the owner will not match the argument when msg.sender is the original owner.
After a non-owner calls setOwner (which reverts), owner must remain unchanged; the buggy version also reverts but incorrectly modifies owner to msg.sender in that reverted call.
After the original owner successfully calls setOwner, the new owner must equal the passed argument; the bug sets owner to msg.sender instead.
After any call to setOwner from the current owner, the owner state variable must equal the argument passed; the bug leaves it unchanged.

For any caller, a successful call to setOwner updates owner to the argument; the buggy version allows a non-owner to change owner, violating the invariant that only the original owner can change the owner.
After any call to setOwner, if the caller is not the current owner, the owner state variable must remain unchanged; the buggy version violates this by allowing a non-owner to change the owner.
After any call to setOwner by a non-owner, the owner state variable must remain unchanged; the buggy modifier allows anyone to change it.
For any caller that is not the original owner, setOwner must revert, so the owner remains unchanged; the buggy version lets any caller change the owner.
After any successful setOwner call, the owner must equal the parameter passed; the bug violates this by leaving owner unchanged.

For any caller that passes the onlyOwner modifier, setOwner should update the owner to the provided argument; the buggy version ignores the argument and always sets owner to address(0), so after a successful call owner() equals address(0) instead of the argument.

After any successful call to setOwner, the contract owner must equal the address that was passed as the _owner argument; the buggy version violates this because it instead sets the owner to msg.sender, which matches _owner only when the caller passes its own address.
